title: 432. Data Stream as Disjoint Intervals

examples.explanation: The distinct values are 1, 2, 3, 6 and 7, forming two blocks.
Consecutive arrivals in reverse still merge into one block.

hints: Keep the disjoint intervals ordered by start in a balanced search tree.
When a value arrives, check the interval just below it and merge every interval that now touches it.
Skip values that are already covered.
